items.title: REX launches 2x leveraged ETF tied to Bitcoin treasury firm Strive
items.summary: The new ASSX fund offers 2x daily exposure to Strive shares, giving traders a leveraged way to bet on the Bitcoin treasury company.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs eke out positive week with $433 million Friday inflow as ether funds snap four-week inflow streak

items.title: How the Clarity Act's Defeat Handed the SEC and CFTC the Wheel on Crypto
items.summary: The Clarity Act failed to advance in the Senate, shifting the industry’s focus to a new wave of action from the SEC and CFTC.
